Picking up where the prior session cut off (mid-investigation of "thin" pages), I found the demo build was actually **crashing on every page** — a `__SECRET_INTERNALS undefined` React error. Fixed by keeping React core + `scheduler` in the same chunk as react-dom. **This also affected the production build** — worth keeping.

I also fixed the one genuinely-broken demo page: `/property/tenants/:id` had no single-record mock route (trades had them, property didn't), so tenant profiles rendered empty. Added the single-tenant + events + tenant-scoped invoice routes in `mock-api.ts`.

The earlier "thin" flags were false positives (number/chart-heavy screens have little innerText).

- **Boot redirect** updated to set the hash (`mock-api.ts`).
